name: context_pruner
description:
Analyzes a list of files or tools currently in an agent's context and recommends which can be safely dropped for the current task — reducing token usage without losing task-critical information.
Use when: context window is filling up, you have many files open and need to trim, or an agent wants to know which loaded resources are irrelevant to the active task.
Scope: local analysis only — scores items by keyword overlap with the task description. No network access, no file reads.
Not for: compressing file content (use token_optimizer), managing persisted memory facts (use memory_write/memory_read), or reading files (use get_file).

task.description: One or two sentences describing the current task or goal. Used as the relevance signal.

items.description: List of context items to evaluate. Each item is a string: a file path, tool name, or short description.

keep_top_n.description: How many items to recommend keeping (highest relevance). Default: 5. Items beyond this threshold are candidates to drop.

verbose.description: If true, include per-item relevance scores and the matched keywords. Default: false.
